**The first release of WBWrite.** It's a live stage whiteboard. Performers write on a touchscreen, and the writing goes to the LED wall over NDI® or HDMI.

### Download

**macOS 13+** (Apple Silicon and Intel, signed and notarized): download **`WBWrite-1.0.0.dmg`**, open it and drag WBWrite into Applications. On first launch, allow **Local Network** access, or NDI won't work.

Linux and Windows are coming soon.

### Features

- One pen, white by default at OpenBoard's thickest default width. Color and width are set before the show.
- An aspect-locked board at your LED wall's exact resolution. The area outside the board is hatched, and the board avoids the MacBook camera notch.
- A large clear button in a corner you choose. It can be single tap, double tap, or turned off completely.
- A clean NDI® feed of the board only, with no UI. The background is black (BGRX) or transparent (BGRA with straight alpha). The source name is configurable, at 23.976–60 fps.
- An optional full-screen clean feed on an HDMI display.
- An on-board status line showing NDI health, measured fps, receiver count, network TX, source name, resolution and battery.
- No toolbars in live mode. Dock and menu bar are hidden, sleep is off, and Esc goes back to setup.
